headline: Leland Bowman Lock closed – log in the gate
dateline: Since 2am Tue Oct 20 · no reopening time yet
what: A log is keeping the gates from working. Crews were on site trying to clear it, with 22 tows already waiting early Tuesday.
why: It's the main GIWW lock between Morgan City and the Calcasieu. Even after it reopens, expect a long line.
todo: Call the lock before you head that way, and wait at Intracoastal City or Delcambre instead of idling at the lock.
source: American Commercial Barge Line river report

headline: Morgan City rail bridge closing for repairs
dateline: 8am Wed Oct 21 – midnight Thu Oct 22 · again Nov 4–5
what: The BNSF railroad bridge over Berwick Bay is listed as closed for repairs during these two windows.
why: The GIWW crosses Berwick Bay right here. Sailboats and taller boats that need the lift span may have to wait.
todo: Need the span raised? Cross before 8am Wednesday or after Thursday night, and call the bridge tender on VHF first.
source: American Commercial Barge Line river report

headline: Calcasieu Lock: weekday daytime closures
what: North chamber wall repairs close the lock on weekdays during the day. The work now runs to about Oct 30, not Sept 18.
why: Show up on a weekday morning and you'll wait until evening behind the commercial queue.
todo: Time your arrival for after 7pm or for the weekend, and call the lock ahead to check the queue.
source: American Commercial Barge Line river report
